verdict.rationale: ChatGPT documents a Plugins/connectors ecosystem — installing named plugins (Slack, Codex Security), connecting to third-party tools like Google Drive, SharePoint, Salesforce, and Gong, and GPT builders choosing 'connected apps' or custom actions from an approved list — which together describe browsing and adding third-party integrations to the assistant. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the actual browse-and-add directory UI/UX and its breadth beyond the named examples.
